violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food item(s) is received at inadequate temperatures: Observed 1% low fat milk at 54F
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received. CFM relocated milk immediately to cooler and wrote violation and corrective action in their report.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Quesadilla, quesadilla in heat lamp at 123, 118F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM relocated quesadillas to the warmer

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed String cheese, string cheese in cold table at 54, 46 F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.CFM relocated cheese to the walk in cooler for cooling down.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at kitchen is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Hot water at handsink at 94F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. CFM submitted a service order for the hand sink and will follow up with the Fairfax County Health Department once the hand sink has been repaired.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed String cheese, yogurt - cold table at 52, 44F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM relocated the string cheese and yogurt to the cooler and removed an over-layer plastic tray. EHS advised staff to store food items on cold table with the metal tray and avoid using unnecessary coverings that may interfere with proper temperature control and airflow.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce (49-52F) in 2 door upright cooler (L)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded lettuce.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 door upright cooler (L) holding at 55F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC removed all TCS food items from cooler and has agreed to discontinue use until repair is complete. PIC has submitted a maintenance request for the repair of the unit. EHS has requested verification of repair before the continuation of use.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water temperature handwashing sink located at the kitchen 54F and restroom 51F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observe the service technicians repair the hot water issue at the handwashing sinks at the time of the inspection. Handwashing sink: kitchen 116F and restroom 110F
